name: model-list-helper-layout-main
goal: Models use the existing helper-function card grid with scoped model and consumer links, retaining search, details, Source actions, and responsive behavior

evidence: Daniel explicitly asked Models to match the existing helper-function lists. Current main routes models through ExplorerTable; reuse the existing ExplorerFunctionCard and responsive grid, keep search and consumer links, and keep source actions only on detail Source. Verify desktop 1440px, tablet 920px and mobile 390px.
Models are routed through the existing ExplorerFunctionCard helper grid; the fixture contains Order and Invoice, and the catalog still retains search, filters, detail navigation, and consumer links.

Red: the unchanged browser scenario failed at desktop, tablet, and mobile when it required 2 model cards and found 1. Green: TAKE_SCREENSHOT=1 ENTITY_PREVIEW_SHOTS=/tmp/harness-model-list-final-20261022 SCREENSHOT_LABEL=main-models bun run --cwd packages/reports test:entities --grep 'models, components, helpers and services use a card grid' passed 3/3; desktop and mobile captures were inspected and show Order and Invoice.

Playwright exercised the model grid, search, shared filter, consumer link, and model detail at 1440x900, 834x1112, and 390x844. All 3 viewport cases passed; fresh desktop/tablet/mobile screenshots were captured, and desktop/mobile pixels were inspected.
